welcome: Welcome to MailHub All your mail in Telegram. Connect Gmail or Yandex and get new-mail alerts right here.
main_menu: Main menu What would you like to do? Open the Mini App with the button beside the message field.
input_placeholder: Write a message or choose an action
choose_provider: Connect an account Choose your mail provider:
auth_instructions: Connect an account Open the link below and grant access. We use it to read mail and mark messages as read. The link expires in 10 minutes.
auth_link_sent: Your authorization link is ready. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth_expired: This authorization link has expired. Start again.
account_connected: Account connected {email} was added. Initial mail is imported without a notification flood.
account_disconnected: Account {email} disconnected. Its MailHub messages were removed.
confirm_unlink: Disconnect account? {email} will stop syncing. This cannot be undone.
no_accounts: No connected accounts Add Gmail or Yandex to get started.
help: Help Connect mail 1. Tap “My accounts” or “Connect”. 2. Choose Gmail or Yandex. 3. Open the link and approve access. Read messages Open the Mini App with the button beside the message field or tap “Open” in a notification. Manage a message Tap “Actions” below a notification to hide mail from the sender, open it in the mailbox, mark it as read, or delete it. Mail is never sent on your behalf. Tokens are encrypted.
oauth_invalid_state: Invalid or expired authorization link. Start again from the bot.
account_deactivated: Account {email} was disabled after repeated sync errors. Reconnect it.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
